<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
exclude_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

# Compute missingness per indicator
results = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    results.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
missingness_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Filter to keep only indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_cols = [col for col in indicator_cols if missingness_df[missingness_df['indicator'] == col]['kept'].iloc[0]]

# Create selected matrix with city_id, city_name, year and selected indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + selected_cols]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>

import pandas as pd
import os

# Read input file
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_report = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_matrix = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the data

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness per indicator
results = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0
    kept = 'True' if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 'False'
    results.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + selected_cols]
selected_df.to_csv(output_matrix, index=False)
